title: A geometric point lifts to some member of a jointly surjective etale family
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $(t_i:T_i\to T)_{i\in I}$ be a family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] which is jointly surjective (every point of $T$ lies in the image of some $t_i$), and let $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ be a geometric point of $T$ [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over $t\in T$. Then there are $i\in I$ and a geometric point $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T_i$ (with the same field $\Omega$) such that $t_i\circ\bar s=\bar t$. More precisely, for every $i$ and every $s\in T_i$ with $t_i(s)=t$ there is such an $\bar s$ lying over $s$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma label lemma-geometric-lift-to-cover, Tag 03PR, applied to the etale neighbourhood $(T,\bar t)$ of $\bar t$ and the etale covering $\{T_i\to T\}$; the field-theoretic form: $\kappa(s)/\kappa(t)$ is finite separable (Morphisms, Lemma label lemma-etale-over-field, Tag 02GL) and so embeds over $\kappa(t)$ into the separably closed field $\Omega$
